crossRefs.note: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,

translations.web: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.
translations.bsb: Such persuasion does not come from the One who calls you.
translations.kjv: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.
translations.asv: This persuasion came not of him that calleth you.
